notes: This file documents the stable authoring-facing template contract, not every private template implementation detail.
When a template is not listed here, treat it as internal or require manual verification before using it as public authoring guidance.
Template paths are consumed relative to the app root through `scene_file`, not through source-repo-only paths.

templates.summary: Reusable titled cockpit panel shell with a header bar and a content body.

stable_inputs.name: title
stable_inputs.notes: Panel title shown by the shell.

stable_inputs.name: blocks
stable_inputs.notes: Inject body blocks into the shell content area.
